summary: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. Parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a commonwealth realm.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor General Stanley JOHN (since 6 January 2026); Prime Minister Godwin FRIDAY (since 28 November 2025)
government: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm
economy: upper middle-income Caribbean island economy; key agriculture and tourism sectors; environmentally fragile; diversifying economy across services, science and knowledge, and creative industries; CARICOM member and US Caribbean Basin Initiative beneficiary GDP (PPP): $1.883 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Ministry of National Security: Royal Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Police Force (RSVPF) (2025)
